meta.name: Lamaste's packages came from Feria, never npmjs
meta.description: 66 — Lamaste's packages came from Feria, never npmjs (Three-VM)

sections.label: The rule, as the host's core resolves it

op.command: timed_exec 120 multipass exec lamaste-host -- sudo bash -c "$(lamalibre_registry_probe_script)"

steps.label: root: the development Feria npm's configuration names ($(probe root))

check.message: root: the development Feria npm's configuration names ($(probe root))

steps.label: the lamaste account: the same, from npm's global configuration ($(probe lamaste))

check.message: the lamaste account: the same, from npm's global configuration ($(probe lamaste))

steps.label: npm with no configuration: the hosted Feria

check.message: npm with no configuration: the hosted Feria

sections.bash:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log_section "The rule, as the host's core resolves it"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PROBE=$(timed_exec 120 multipass exec lamaste-host -- sudo bash -c "$(lamalibre_registry_probe_script)")
log_info "$(printf '%s' "${PROBE}" | tr '\n' ';')"
probe() { printf '%s\n' "${PROBE}" | awk -v k="$1" '$1 == k { print $2 }'; }
assert_contains "$(probe root)" ":4873/" "root: the development Feria npm's configuration names ($(probe root))" || true
assert_contains "$(probe lamaste)" ":4873/" "the lamaste account: the same, from npm's global configuration ($(probe lamaste))" || true
assert_eq "$(probe unconfigured)" "https://feria.codelama.com.tr/" "npm with no configuration: the hosted Feria" || true
assert_eq "$(probe npmjs)" "refused:lamalibre_registry_refused" "npm naming npmjs for @lamalibre: refused" || true

sections.label: The evidence: npm's caches and logs on every VM

steps.label: ${VM}: $(printf '%s' "${EVIDENCE}" | grep -c . || true) @lamalibre URLs in npm's caches and logs, $(printf '%s' "${DEV}" | grep -c . || true) from the development Feria

op.message: ${VM}: $(printf '%s' "${EVIDENCE}" | grep -c . || true) @lamalibre URLs in npm's caches and logs, $(printf '%s' "${DEV}" | grep -c . || true) from the development Feria

steps.label: ${VM}: npm's caches hold @lamalibre requests to the development Feria (the evidence is there to read)

check.message: ${VM}: npm's caches hold @lamalibre requests to the development Feria (the evidence is there to read)

steps.label: ${VM}: @lamalibre was asked of a public registry or the hosted Feria: $(printf '%s' "${PUBLIC}" | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')

op.message: ${VM}: @lamalibre was asked of a public registry or the hosted Feria: $(printf '%s' "${PUBLIC}" | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')

steps.label: ${VM}: no @lamalibre request to npmjs, its mirrors or the hosted Feria

op.message: ${VM}: no @lamalibre request to npmjs, its mirrors or the hosted Feria

sections.bash:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log_section "The evidence: npm's caches and logs on every VM"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

for VM in host agent visitor; do
  EVIDENCE=$(timed_exec 180 multipass exec "lamaste-${VM}" -- sudo bash -c "$(npm_fetch_evidence_script)")
  PUBLIC=$(public_registry_fetches "${EVIDENCE}")
  DEV=$(dev_feria_fetches "${EVIDENCE}")
  log_info "${VM}: $(printf '%s' "${EVIDENCE}" | grep -c . || true) @lamalibre URLs in npm's caches and logs, $(printf '%s' "${DEV}" | grep -c . || true) from the development Feria"
  if [ "${VM}" != "visitor" ]; then
    assert_not_eq "$(printf '%s' "${DEV}" | grep -c . || true)" "0" "${VM}: npm's caches hold @lamalibre requests to the development Feria (the evidence is there to read)" || true
  fi
  if [ -n "${PUBLIC}" ]; then
    log_fail "${VM}: @lamalibre was asked of a public registry or the hosted Feria: $(printf '%s' "${PUBLIC}" | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  else
    log_pass "${VM}: no @lamalibre request to npmjs, its mirrors or the hosted Feria"
  fi
done

sections.label: The root helper's self-update names the registry

steps.label: …and refuses a root npmrc naming npmjs

check.message: …and refuses a root npmrc naming npmjs

sections.bash:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log_section "The root helper's self-update names the registry"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

ARGV=$(host_exec "node -e 'const p = require(\"/usr/local/sbin/lamaste-priv\"); process.stdout.write(p.selfUpdateArgs(\"9.9.9\", p.chooseLamalibreRegistry(\"undefined\"), \"u\").join(\" \"))'" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
assert_contains "${ARGV}" "/usr/bin/npx --yes --@lamalibre:registry=https://feria.codelama.com.tr/ @lamalibre/create-lamaste@9.9.9 --yes" "lamaste-priv self-update: npx --@lamalibre:registry=<registry> create-lamaste@<version>" || true
REFUSED=$(host_exec "node -e 'const p = require(\"/usr/local/sbin/lamaste-priv\"); try { p.chooseLamalibreRegistry(\"https://registry.npmjs.org/\"); process.stdout.write(\"accepted\"); } catch { process.stdout.write(\"refused\"); }'" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
assert_eq "${REFUSED}" "refused" "…and refuses a root npmrc naming npmjs" || true

headerRaw:
# ============================================================================
# 66 — Lamaste's packages came from Feria, never npmjs (Three-VM)
# ============================================================================
# Since 4.14 every path that installs or checks Lamaste's own @lamalibre
# packages takes them from the hosted Feria, or from the registry npm's
# configuration names for @lamalibre — never npm's default registry, npmjs
# (packages/core/docs/05-operations/upgrades.md, "Where Lamaste's packages
# come from"). The VMs name the development Feria for @lamalibre in every
# npmrc they have (tier node-ready: root's, ubuntu's and npm's global one).
# Run last, after every other spec has installed what it installs:
#
# 1. The rule, on the host VM, as 4.14's core resolves it: root and the
#    lamaste account follow the configuration (the development Feria); an npm
#    with no configuration resolves the hosted Feria (nothing is fetched); an
#    npm naming npmjs for @lamalibre is refused.
# 2. The evidence, on all three VMs: npm's cache index and debug logs, of
#    every user, hold @lamalibre requests to the development Feria (on the
#    host and the agent: what was installed there) and none to a public
#    registry or to the hosted Feria — on any path: the installer, the
#    panel's plugin and agent-half installs, the agent's setup, sync and
#    plugin installs, the app host's npm pack.
# 3. The relay's root helper runs the self-update's npx with
#    --@lamalibre:registry=.
# ============================================================================
